name: Report a pothole
whatHappensNext: A highways inspector will assess the pothole within 5 working days. We will not normally contact you unless we need more information.

pages.hintText: Give the street and nearest house number or landmark.
Include rough size and anything that makes it dangerous.

pages.questionText: How many potholes are there at this location?
Upload a photo of the pothole

pages.hintText: So we can contact you if we need more detail.
